# criblio_monitors (Data Source)

Monitors DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_monitors" "my_monitors" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `dataset_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `detection_config` (String) Detection configuration as JSON.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `expr` (String) Expression transformations as JSON. Use jsonencode([...]).
- `firing_condition` (String) Firing condition as JSON. Use jsonencode({ fire_delay = N, clear_delay = M }).
- `firing_rule` (String) Firing rule as JSON.
- `id` (String)
- `managed_by` (String) Stamped 'terraform' by the backend when provisioned via the Terraform provider (cribl/cribl#43133).
- `metadata` (String) Metadata as JSON. Use jsonencode({}).
- `name` (String)
- `notification` (String) Notification config as JSON.
- `priority` (Attributes) Monitor priority. Profile-linked inheritance is not supported by this provider yet -- set value directly, e.g. { value = "P1" }. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--priority))
- `query` (String) Query config as JSON. Use jsonencode({ A = { mode = "promql", promql = "..." } }).
- `search_mode` (String) Search mode for logs monitors: 'new' or 'saved'. Defaults to 'new'.
- `team` (Attributes) Owning team. Profile-linked inheritance is not supported by this provider yet -- set value directly, e.g. { value = "platform" }. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--team))
- `template_params` (String) Per-query template parameters as JSON, keyed by query label. Use jsonencode({ A = { ... } }).
- `type` (String)
- `unit` (String)
